name: Fuefukigawa Fruit Park
description: Perched on the hillside above Kofu, Fuefukigawa Fruit Park is one of Japan's New Three Great Night Views (2003), famous for its panoramic evening view of the Kofu basin.
notes: Free entry; the observation deck and seasonal illumination are the highlights. Combine with a daytime fruit-picking visit.
